These gzip/OpenPGP fixtures were generated by the original encb.py functions
`_create_archive_mem` and `_create_archive_stream`, using the public test password
`encb fixture password`. The original functions were executed unchanged; only
logging and progress display were replaced with no-op adapters. No cloud code
was executed.

Source SHA-256:
`63c4661db83110684bbbd1c59862c400100fca9a74fd9c33df875ca2f704e95c`

Each fixture contains binary data, an empty directory, a symlink, a hard link,
and a long PAX path. Tests decrypt them internally without external executables.
